sysbench.command: python3 rust/scripts/compare-sysbench.py --server before:53011 --server after:53012 --server go:45000 --database perf_sysbench_locking_v2 --workload oltp_read_write --threads 2 --seconds 20 --rounds 3 --table-size 100000 --output /private/tmp/tidb-prelock-sysbench-comparison
sysbench.topology: Only current before/after Rust and Go servers remained active; five superseded benchmark servers were stopped before warmup. Both builds measured under the same topology.
sysbench.conclusion: Median improves 0.74 percent; two paired rounds improve and one declines. No strong or Go-relative throughput win. No compilation or profiling overlapped.

tpcc.conclusion: Two-client median rises 2.81 percent with mixed pairs; eight-client median falls 13.87 percent and two pairs decline. No successful broad throughput optimization; investigate the high-concurrency result. Shared evolving data and time-seeded inputs remain measurement limitations.
tpcc.latency_evidence: Eight-client after round 0 has NEW_ORDER max 4831.8 ms and PAYMENT max 4160.7 ms despite ordinary medians 5.2/4.7 ms. Before round 1 also has NEW_ORDER max 4160.7 ms; Go round 1 has PAYMENT max 1946.2 ms. These tails require investigation; they do not establish causation by this edit.
